instruction: A candid outdoor full shot captures a sunny grassy park with tall trees in the background. On the left, the East Asian man in a red polo shirt (R3) leans forward in a deep squat, pulling a yellow rope. On the right, the Black woman in a red t-shirt (R5) bends deeply at the waist, pulling the yellow rope. They are playing a competitive game of tug-of-war together, holding onto the rope with both hands. The scene is illuminated by bright, natural daylight, casting soft shadows on the green grass.
